_comment: Universal Golden Path template for multi-scene cinematic media. The engine reads this file when --dispatch-template is passed, calls scene-decomposer once to produce the scene manifest + production bible, then dispatches per-scene workers in parallel (hero image + voiceover + video clip per scene), then calls editor.stitch to assemble the final MP4. Designed for short-form cinematic work (30s-3min) where Hailuo-2.3's 10s clip limit and H3's 15s clip limit need to be worked around by stitching N clips into one assembled video. Works for: short films, narrative ads, product launches, brand stories, social shorts.
name: cinematic-short
objective_template:
{{project_title}} -- cinematic-short recipe

Source: {{source_markdown}} (read this file as the canonical content).
Target total duration: {{target_duration_s}}s. Max scene duration: {{max_scene_s}}s. Aspect: {{aspect}}. Style: {{style}}. Palette: {{palette}}. Voice: {{voice}}.

## Continuity rules
  - Read production_bible.json before every per-scene worker call -- the same character must look the same in every scene
  - All heroes share the palette hint: {{palette}}
  - All voiceover uses the {{voice}} voice preset
  - All video clips are at {{aspect}} aspect ratio
  - Crossfade between scenes is {{crossfade_s}}s (default 0.5s)

## High-stakes gates
  - Gate 1 (HIGH) after scene manifest is produced -- operator approves the storyboard + production bible before per-scene workers run
  - Gate 2 (CRITICAL) after all per-scene workers + BGM complete -- operator approves the assembled storyboard before final edit
  - Gate 3 (HIGH) after editor.stitch writes the final MP4 -- operator approves the deliverable before it's written to the durable deliverables/<project>/ folder

substitutions.project_title: Human-readable project name, e.g. 'Acme product launch teaser' or 'VORTEX-OS announcement trailer'
substitutions.source_markdown: Absolute path to the source markdown / script file, e.g. 'briefs/acme_launch.md'
substitutions.max_scene_s: Integer, max 8 (leaves headroom under Hailuo-2.3's 10s cap and H3's 15s cap; default 8)
substitutions.aspect: Output aspect ratio, one of: 16:9 (desktop) | 9:16 (short-form / mobile) | 1:1 (social)
substitutions.palette: Color palette hint, free-text, e.g. 'cool teal and warm amber, low contrast'
substitutions.voice: Voice preset, one of: default | male-1 | female-1 | child
substitutions.crossfade_s: Crossfade duration between scenes in seconds (default 0.5)

deliverables.name: production_bible
deliverables.description: Continuity bible: title, style, palette, voice, aspect, character list. Lives at $VORTEX_HOME/state/<project>/production/production_bible.json. Every worker reads it before generating.

deliverables.name: scene_manifest
deliverables.description: Scene list with index, duration_s, title, visual_brief, audio_brief, transition_in, transition_out, characters, deliverable_refs. Lives at $VORTEX_HOME/state/<project>/production/scenes.json.

deliverables.name: per_scene_hero
deliverables.description: One hero image per scene, generated by image-cover, in the project style + palette. Written to $VORTEX_HOME/deliverables/<project>/imgs/scene-NN-hero.png.

deliverables.name: per_scene_voiceover
deliverables.description: One voiceover segment per scene, generated by audio-voice, with the project's voice preset. Written to $VORTEX_HOME/deliverables/<project>/audio/scene-NN-voiceover.wav.

deliverables.name: per_scene_clip
deliverables.description: One cinematic video clip per scene, generated by video-hailuo (Hailuo-2.3), respecting each scene's duration_s. Written to $VORTEX_HOME/deliverables/<project>/video/scene-NN-clip.mp4.

deliverables.name: background_music
deliverables.description: One BGM track, generated by audio-music, that sits under all voiceover at the editor's BGM volume. Written to $VORTEX_HOME/state/<project>/production/bgm.wav.

deliverables.name: final_video
deliverables.description: Assembled final video with crossfades between scenes, voiceover mixed with BGM at the editor's volume levels. Generated by editor.stitch. Written to $VORTEX_HOME/deliverables/<project>/<project>-final.mp4.

hitl_gates.ask: Approve the scene manifest + production bible before per-scene workers run?
Approve the assembled storyboard (heroes + voiceovers + clips + BGM) before final edit?
Approve the final pack for delivery to deliverables/<project>/?

self_heal_targets: Character drift (the same character looks different in two scenes)
Palette drift (a hero image doesn't match the production_bible palette)
Voice drift (a voiceover uses a different voice than production_bible.voice)
Aspect drift (a video clip is at a different aspect than production_bible.aspect)
Duration overrun (a scene's video clip is longer than scene.duration_s)
Transition mismatch (a scene's transition_in is incompatible with the previous scene's transition_out)
dispatch_examples: # Master-objective dispatch (if you want to write the objective by hand):
Target total duration: 60s. Max scene duration: 8s. Aspect: 16:9. Style: cinematic. Palette: cool teal and warm amber. Voice: default.
(... see objective_template above for the full objective ...)
